data_boundary: Identifiers are positive surrogate keys for exact observed documents, versions, issuers and handmarks; zero represents an absent/unidentified association. They are technical record identities, not legally assigned numeric thresholds. The module tests documentary mechanism conformance, not statutory applicability or contract validity.

observable_leaf_classifications.reason: Identity of the retained document being assessed. Represented by a stable positive surrogate key for the exact observed identity, with zero for absent/unidentified evidence. Surrogates preserve identity across the matching record fields; the caller does not choose a legal-status code. This is a technical representation convention, not a statutory numerical threshold. The rule derives the required association matches and rejects missing identities. Observable evidence for the limited BGB126(1) documentary signature mechanism only; statutory writing applicability, whole-contract validity, other writing substitutes and Kindergeld eligibility remain separate legal computations.
